Persona Meera is FICTIONAL and labelled so. Every number comes from the recorded run (runs/20261017-002725-602783) / eval files.

scenes.caption: Fictional shop owner. The problem is real: a shop I know counts stock by hand.
scenes.text: Meera counts her gift shop's stock by hand. And she keeps guessing wrong. Some weeks, the fast seller's gone. Other weeks? Boxes nobody wants, piling up.

scenes.caption: Real app. Demo file: public UCI Online Retail II, headers renamed Bill No, Maal, Kitne, Tarikh
scenes.text: So one day, she drops her order export into tidy-predict.

scenes.caption: Replay a past week, label the data as a demo, go
scenes.text: She picks a past week to replay. Labels the data. And hits go.

scenes.caption: Headers the rules cannot place go to Gemma, running on this laptop
scenes.text: Her headers are odd, so Gemma, right on the laptop, reads them. Tarikh is the date. Kitne, the quantity. Maal, the product.
scenes.say: Her headers are odd, so Gemma, right on the laptop, reads them. Taareekh is the date. Kitney, the quantity. Maal, the product.

scenes.caption: Cleaned, nothing deleted silently. TabPFN-2 forecasts the 20 regular sellers
scenes.text: Over a million rows get cleaned. Then TabPFN-2 forecasts her twenty regular sellers.
scenes.say: Over a million rows get cleaned. Then Tab P F N two forecasts her twenty regular sellers.

scenes.caption: Gemma writes the note; code checks every number in it
scenes.text: Gemma writes the note. And plain code checks every number in it.

scenes.caption: Her restock note: what to have ready for a busy week
scenes.text: And here's her restock note. What to have ready for a busy week.

scenes.caption: A likely range per product, and what really sold
scenes.text: Next to each item, there's a likely range, and what really sold. Seventeen of twenty landed inside.

scenes.caption: Rabbit night light: 4,452 sold, vs a busy-week number of 2,592
scenes.text: Now, the honest miss. Rabbit night lights sold about forty-four hundred. Way above the busy-week number, about twenty-six hundred.

scenes.caption: Meera's next step (fictional): the tool gives a number, she still decides
scenes.text: Meera stocks to the busy-week number, keeps a few spares, and still checks the shelf herself.

scenes.caption: Every set-aside row is listed. Open models, local, licensed for paid use
scenes.text: Everything set aside is listed. Open models, run locally.
